name: mint-for-mac
description: Mint is a Mac app that keeps disk and memory healthy for you and the AI agents working on your Mac. Through Mint's own engine and checks, Cursor's agent sees what grew, gets space back, much of it without deleting a file, frees memory from apps you aren't using and knows what coding agents leave behind. Anything that deletes for good, quits an app or changes settings is confirmed in Mint.
